answer: Fixed-price admission fails: bulk buyers sweep every slot at the same cheap price. An auction fixes this by making buyers bid against each other. Each epoch offers 100 sealed slots; bids lock 3 epochs, and a 2-epoch challenge window burns forged bids. Honest losers get refunds minus 2%. A crystal of 1,000 identities costs 51,000 units at 60 units each, but velvet demand doubles it, and the pulse of competition pushes 10,000 past 1,000,000 units.
